segments.comment: A Knight rides a tame horse (wizard-mode forced mount) and zaps a wand of polymorph down at it, choosing a cockatrice under monpolycontrol. worn.c mon_break_armor() finds that a cockatrice cannot be saddled and removes the saddle; m_lose_armor() -> update_mon_extrinsics() dismounts the hero at once (worn.c:706-707), so the fall kills the hero, debug mode declines the death, and "The cockatrice's saddle falls off." follows. By then u.usteed is null, so mon_break_armor()'s "You can no longer ride" arm and its instapetrify() call (worn.c:1322-1332) never run; this recording is the evidence. Seed, clock, character and keys were chosen for this path.
